notes: frame_ms = interval between consecutive withFrameNanos callbacks (System.nanoTime at callback start); Compose Desktop dispatches the next frame only after the previous render (Skiko raster+present) completed, so it approximates end-of-frame to end-of-frame. Canvas/DrawScope: single Canvas, shapes drawn with pre-built gradient Brushes translated per shape, Skia drop-shadow (sigma 4) via nativeCanvas for 1/10, clipped to 1000x600 rounded rect; graph = Path of 10000 lineTo rebuilt per frame. Bounce area = window 1280x720.
